content: Claude in Chrome is a Claude-Code-internal MCP server named claude-in-chrome, driven by the Claude in Chrome browser extension (v1.0.36+) over a native-messaging host. It is strictly attended: browser actions run in a visible Chrome window in real time and Claude pauses for login pages and CAPTCHAs. It requires a direct Anthropic plan (Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise) and interactive /login - API-key or claude setup-token sessions have Chrome integration force-disabled even with --chrome. Not supported in WSL and not available via Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry. Enabled with 'claude --chrome' or /chrome 'Enabled by default'; loading it always costs context. Organisations can block it via the deniedMcpServers managed setting. It is not installable in Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode or Copilot CLI. Conclusion: unusable for headless CI.
